events.name: ADMETA
events.longDesc: Freedom is hammered out on the anvil of discussion, dissent, and debate. Debate is a force for good that has the power to change anything- from politics to the hearts of people. As citizens of the world, it is better to debate a question without settling it than to settle a question without debating it. At Admeta, we invite you to embrace the powers of logic and emotion to debate on topics that govern the universe around us. This event will force you to maintain composure under extreme pressure and use persuasion as your foremost tool. Welcome to Admeta, an epitome of the saying, “The pen is mightier than the sword.” The podium awaits you.

events.name: ARTEM
events.longDesc: A haven where ideas materialise, originality steals the spotlight and feelings are expressed as a vibrant spectrum. Here, visual communication expresses your creativity, encouraging you to create change in the perpetually evolving field of art. This is an invitation for you to be a part of an event that lets you run wild with your imagination, break conformities and establish a new era of art.

events.name: CARMEN
events.longDesc: Step into the world of Carmen, where emotions find meaning through words and imagination takes centre stage. Whether through introspective poetry or captivating spoken performance, this event invites participants to channel passion, vulnerability, and creativity. Here, verses evolve into powerful expressions, and voices transform into stories that leave lasting impressions.

events.name: FABULA
events.longDesc: Fabula is a celebration of storytelling, where ideas evolve into powerful visual narratives. The event invites participants to explore the essence of change, whether subtle or profound, internal or external through the medium of film. It challenges teams to craft stories that capture moments of transition, growth, and redefinition with creativity and depth. At Fabula, every story visualised is defined not just by how it begins, but by how it transforms.

events.name: FORTUNA
events.longDesc: Fortuna - Perseverantia’s own version of Dalal Street is a high-intensity stock market simulation that transforms students into investors and traders. Inspired by our theme, Metamorphosis, the market is constantly evolving. Fortunes rise, companies collapse, and every decision has the power to alter the course of the market. In a world driven by risk, instinct, and strategy, participants must adapt faster than the market itself. Only the smartest and most calculating investors will emerge victorious when the closing bell rings.

events.name: CODEFERNO
events.longDesc: CCodeferno is a high-intensity coding competition designed to challenge participants to think critically and solve complex problems. Codeferno pushes participants to perform under tight timelines, compete with others, and realise that problems which appear simple can turn out to be deceptively complex—all while building real experience in a competitive programming environment.

events.name: GUSTATIO
events.longDesc: Welcome to Gustatio, where gastronomy meets imagination and creativity fuels competition. More than just a cook-off, this is a high-pressure culinary experience where participants must innovate, adapt, and think beyond the ordinary. Through teamwork, skill, and strategy, transform simple ingredients into extraordinary dishes that embody the spirit of metamorphosis. Are you up for the challenge?

events.name: MAHIM16
events.longDesc: Mahim16 — inspired by Brooklyn 99 — is a thrilling mystery-based crime event where teams step into the shoes of investigators to crack a complex case. Using a starter podcast, witness interactions, and an evidence file, teams must analyse the crime, build an investigation board, and narrate their theory of the case.

events.name: ‘Ad’venturium
events.longDesc: ‘Jo dikhta hai, woh bikta hai.’ Welcome to Ad’venturium, where imagination meets persuasion, and creativity drives your business. In worlds shaped by dystopia, fantasy, or futuristic realities, your product must adapt to survive. Test your wit, innovation, and storytelling skills as you craft compelling advertisements that transform limitations into opportunities and ideas into impact.

events.name: GRATIA
events.longDesc: ‘Change is not always comfortable, but it is necessary.’ Inspired by the theme of Perseverantia, Metamorphosis, and the theme of Gratia, our dance event is ‘The Turning Point.’ From the first beat to the final pose, the stage evolves into a space of constant transformation, where identities shift, limits are broken, and artistry takes flight.

events.name: PANACHE
events.longDesc: In Panache, fashion becomes a narrative where every garment carries a story shaped by time and transformation. Teams are challenged to conceptualise and execute a fashion show inspired by metamorphosis, exploring how materials evolve from the ordinary into the extraordinary. Let your designs capture change, growth, and reinvention, because the runway is yours to command.

events.name: SYMPHONIA
events.longDesc: Welcome to Symphonia, where rhythm becomes identity and music tells stories words cannot. This two-day celebration of sound invites performers to showcase originality, passion, and authenticity through every note. From soulful melodies to electrifying performances, bands transform emotions into experiences, creating music that resonates long after the final chord. From indie vibes to folk roots, your band will tell a story, one beat at a time.

events.name: MR AND MS PERSEVERANTIA
events.longDesc: Are you ready to explore the depths of your personality and embrace who you truly are? Do you possess the courage, charisma, and perseverance to prove your mettle to the world? This is your chance to step into the spotlight, push past fear and doubt, and let your passion and presence shine. Join us for the most-awaited and fiercely competitive event of Perseverantia 2026 — where confidence meets glamour and only the best rise above the rest. Ladies and gentlemen, we proudly present the flagship event of the year — Mr. & Ms. Perseverantia 2026.

events.name: EXPLORARE
events.longDesc: Embark on an enigmatic adventure, undergo a thrilling process of metamorphosis from the past to the future. Starting in the shadows of ancient legacies, teams evolve through cryptic chambers, shedding old-world riddles for cutting-edge enigmas, forging their destiny shard by shard. Race the collapsing timeline to claim the ultimate relic—will you emerge transformed, or lost in the flux?

events.name: FOOTBALL
events.longDesc: At Perseverantia, football isn't just a sport — it's a full-blown spectacle. Expect fierce goals, electrifying plays, and roaring cheers as schools battle it out in a 5-a-side showdown. With mystery cards, the pressure of time, and knockout stakes, this is where grit meets glory. Whether you're scoring or supporting, get ready for a matchday you won't forget. When the whistle blows — the game is on!

events.name: BASKETBALL
events.longDesc: Where the court ignites, the crowd holds its breath, and every second carries the thrill of possibility — welcome to Basketball. Experience electrifying teamwork, fierce competition, and moments of brilliance where every dribble, pass, and shot tells a story. Under pressure and passion, players transform determination into triumph and ambition into unforgettable performances.

events.name: GULLY CRICKET
events.longDesc: From Sachin Tendulkar to Smriti Mandhana, every cricketing icon once began with the spirit of gully cricket, where the pitch was uneven, the rules were negotiable, and every game felt like a final. This event celebrates the raw passion of the sport, where talent evolves through challenge, teamwork thrives, and endless determination shapes unforgettable moments, and every match feels like a World Cup final.

events.name: TABLE TENNIS
events.longDesc: Fast, ruthless, and unforgiving, table tennis isn’t just a casual knock-around; it’s a test of reflexes, control, and who breaks first under pressure. This event is for those who can handle intensity, stay sharp, and keep their composure when it matters. Build your team, step up to the table, and be ready to fight for every single point—because once it starts, there’s no easy way out.

events.name: TUG OF WAR
events.longDesc: Tug of War isn't just muscle; it's mind over might. Strategy, strength, and synergy collide in the ultimate test of teamwork. In Tug of War: Every pull counts, every teammate matters, and every second is a battle for control. With high-stakes rounds and a twist of unpredictability, victory will go to the team that knows how to stay grounded — literally and figuratively.

events.name: E-SPORTS
events.longDesc: Step into the digital battlefield as Perseverantia hosts a thrilling E-Sports showdown, uniting participants in an intense, strategy-driven competition. Participants will test their skills, teamwork, communication, and composure under pressure. Amid fast-paced gameplay and fierce rivalry, players will push their limits and showcase exceptional talent, where only the best will rise to victory.

events.name: CAPTURA
events.longDesc: Captura is not like other photography contests. It's a test of your ability to react to what you see, be flexible with your art, and handle the unexpected. In a time when photography is often associated with carefully planned events, this event asks participants to find order and meaning in the unpredictable rhythm of a living space. It prioritises spontaneous reaction over planned composition, challenging photographers to abandon pre-set ideas. Do you have what it takes to reveal the beauty in the chaos?

events.name: CHESS
events.longDesc: Chess started in India over 1,500 years ago as “Chaturanga”. It has become a classic test of intelligence. This event is all about metamorphosis, which is part of this very game, known for changing all the time. There are more possible chess positions than stars in the observable universe. Now, will your stars align as you rise to the challenge and transform your game?

events.name: NEGOTIUM
events.longDesc: Entrepreneurial skills? Check. Otherworldly persuasiveness? Check. Financial wizardry? Check. If you’re the person who generates business ideas like a chef crafts recipes, you have come to the right place. Where ideas meet practicality and your pitch is your super-power in front of the Sharks: Welcome to Perseverantia’s very own version of Shark Tank - Negotium.

events.name: RESPUBLICA
events.longDesc: Former Canadian Prime Minister John Diefenbaker once famously quoted, “Parliament is more than a procedure—it is a custodian of the nation’s freedom.”At Respublica, we aim to replicate our efficient legislature. This event will give you an insight into the functioning of our legislature and give you an opportunity to provide effective solutions to the problems faced by India. PRS India is a knowledge partner for Respublica.

about.tb1: Perseverantia 2026 celebrates the spirit of resilience, creativity, and meaningful collaboration. As Bombay Scottish School's annual interschool fest, it brings together young minds from across the city to engage in dialogue, performance, and competition across a wide range of disciplines. Rooted in the values of excellence and integrity, Perseverantia is a platform where talent meets purpose and innovation meets community.
about.tbg: The theme for Perseverantia's 4th edition is OFFTHENTIC.
about.tb2: It calls upon participants to reflect on the importance of authenticity in an increasingly digital world. In a time shaped by social media filters, fast trends, and virtual personas, OFFTHENTIC is an invitation to go offline, to reconnect with one's roots, embrace originality, and express identity in its truest form. Each event has been carefully curated to inspire honest self-expression and thoughtful reflection, ensuring that this year's edition of Perseverantia is not just memorable, but deeply meaningful.

register.content: Be part of Perseverantia '26 and showcase your talents across 21+ thrilling events. Don't miss your chance to compete, collaborate, and celebrate!
